title: Galveston pianists, the Seven Aces and Houston trumpeters
summary: Manno covers Jack Sharp, Albert Anderson and the Seven Aces, then Houston trumpeters including Vic Ensurello, Benny Bell, Kit Reed and Neil Hoard.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
